notes: Golden cases mined from the r4 rehearsal (read-only copy of checkpoints.sqlite). Each case rebuilds the real task packet at that gate, swaps in the CURRENT kit's studio snapshot (skills, rubrics, models) and runs the assigned crew role on it. History references (#N) are indexes into the r4 project history. Assertions are machine-checked; soft assertions are reported but never fail a case. June (scene-reviewer) has no cases: r4 stopped before keyframes, so there is no ground truth for her yet.

Option 2 was the clean sheet Shaz picked (#160).

truth.summary: Every location in backgrounds v1 has an empty angles array, and every approved shot in the r4 plan binds angleId null (uses the main background plate). Under the master-plate rule adopted after r4, that configuration is correct, so Sage must APPROVE and must not invent an angles defect. asserts.why: Every approved shot uses the main plate; empty secondary-angles is correct under the master-plate rule.
Rejecting for empty/missing angles invents a defect: the r4 shot plan needs no secondary angles.
